newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA'S FINANCIAL MAIL EDITOR QUITS.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA'S FINANCIAL MAIL EDITOR QUITS.

text.p: South Africa's Financial Mail editor Nigel Bruce said on Wednesday he had resigned from the local business publication following a disagreement with management.
Bruce told South African radio that he was considering various employment options, including working with former colleague David Gleason who recently bought out rival publication Finance Week.

Industry sources say negotiations are well advanced for Britain's Pearson Plc , publisher of the Financial Times, to take a 50 percent stake in South Africa's Financial Mail and Business Day from Times Media Ltd .
